name: Carousel
source:
Tarou is your average high schooler with an average life. Though everything goes awry when his classmate Ainisa claims to be his girlfriend, who he has no recollection of.

[From [url=https://lunariamv.tumblr.com/post/741000819810451456]the developer's blog[/url]]
translation:
太郎是一个普通的高中生，过着普通的生活。然而，当他的同学艾尼萨声称自己是他的女朋友时，一切都出了问题，而他却不记得是谁了。

[来自[url=https://lunariamv.tumblr.com/post/741000819810451456]开发者博客[/url]]
